_about: pingalto.com English (/en/...): for Argentine gamers and people playing from Argentina. keep = names that stay as written (also allowed by the Spanish-words gate on /en/ pages); terms = how a Spanish word is said in English by players. urlRule = how tools/translate.mjs --meta writes English addresses. Used by tools/translate.mjs (docs/I18N.md).
audience: Argentine gamers (teens and young adults, and anyone playing from Argentina) who prefer English. Same Argentine substance as the Spanish site: provinces, the LAS server, ping to Santiago and São Paulo, Argentina time, Argentine players and teams, prices in pesos. Casual, friendly gamer English (American spelling), second person (you) for the Spanish vos, short sentences, no hype, no new claims. Game words exactly as English-speaking players and the games' own English clients say them.
money: Amounts are Argentine pesos written "$ 1,234" (dollar sign, space, English separators); never convert to US dollars; say "pesos" where the Spanish says pesos.
time: Times stay on the 24-hour clock as written ("21:00"); "hora argentina" = "Argentina time"; "hora de Argentina" = "Argentina time".
urlRule: "/en" + the Spanish path with its descriptive words in English: lowercase ASCII words joined by "-", NO trailing slash, the same number of folders as the Spanish url; the home "/" is "/en". Game and section words stay as they are: valorant, cs2, lol, dota2, ff, fortnite, brawl, clash, rl, eafc, esports, kit, tier-list; proper names stay too: ascent, split, major, worlds, msi, ti, champions, latam, max, brawlers, ping, dpi. Translate the descriptive words: rangos -> ranks, agentes -> agents, mapas -> maps, mira -> crosshair, sensibilidad -> sensitivity, nombres -> names, espacio-invisible -> invisible-space, codigos -> codes, nube -> cloud, mazos -> decks, cartas -> cards, meta -> meta, eventos -> events, agenda -> schedule, argentinos -> argentine-players, sistema-suizo -> swiss-system, series -> series, glosario -> glossary, equipo -> team, metodo -> method, datos -> data, contacto -> contact, legal -> legal. Unique.

terms.rango (Valorant): Hierro, Bronce, Plata,: Valorant ranks by their English names: Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Ascendant, Immortal, Radiant
terms.CR (Valorant, Clasificación de Rango): RR (Rank Rating); but CR as the short name of Clash Royale stays CR
terms.rango (LoL): Hierro, Bronce, Plata, Oro,: LoL tiers by their English names: Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, Master, Grandmaster, Challenger
terms.punto rojo / mira 2x / mira 4x / mira de: Free Fire sensitivity sliders as the English client says them: Red Dot, 2x Scope, 4x Scope, Sniper Scope, Free Look
terms.Luchador, Tanque, Mago, Asesino, Tirador: Fighter, Tank, Mage, Assassin, Marksman, Support
terms.cartas, brawlers, agentes, campeones, ha: use their official English in-game names
terms.callouts: callouts (the names players give to spots on a map)
terms.espacio invisible: invisible space (an invisible character for names)
terms.SUBE: SUBE card (the Argentine transit card, same size as a bank card)
terms.Alt: Alt, the site's character made with AI
terms.sin apuestas, sin skins, sin cajas: no betting, no skins, no loot boxes
